title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Community Boost is seeking a Performance Marketing Manager who is equal parts client strategist, media buyer and technical executor in Google/Meta ads. In this role, you will be the primary strategic partner for a dedicated portfolio of small size nonprofit clients. This role reports to the Director of Client Services and is responsible for the holistic health of the client relationship-leading the conversation, designing the roadmap, and personally executing the media buying that brings that roadmap to life. This role is a REMOTE POSITION and can be anywhere in the US.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities

•
Strategic Consulting: Act as the lead advisor for a portfolio of nonprofit partners. Identify growth opportunities, troubleshoot organizational challenges, and align digital tactics with long-term fundraising goals.

•
Client Relationship Management: Lead all client-facing communications for 15 clients, including monthly strategy sessions and performance deep-dives.

•
Full-Stack Channel Execution: Own the hands-on execution and optimization across major platforms including Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search, PMAX, Grant). Perform weekly account health checks to refine bidding, audiences, ad creative, and campaign structures to maximize ROAS and CPA targets.

•
Narrative Reporting: You know how to move beyond "vanity metrics." and be able to articulate the why behind performance trends to Marketing Directors and Nonprofit Boards.

•
Omnichannel Strategy & Attribution: Drive integrated strategies across multiple channels (Paid Search, Social, Programmatic). Utilize advanced attribution concepts (multi-touch, LTV, incrementality) to provide a holistic view using GA4 and Ninjacat to track how channels drive donor acquisition and long-term value.

•
Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Develop and implement a disciplined testing framework, including monthly hypotheses, recommended variants, implementation, and reporting on results to maximize on-page conversions.

•
Project Management: Maintaining project management using Asana and Basecamp, and ensuring all client deliverables are met on time without internal oversight.

Qualifications

•
Deep Channel Expertise (Required): Primary experience must be in Google Ads Grant and Meta Ads Manager, with a strong background in other paid media such as Programmatic (Display) and video (YouTube). You must be comfortable jumping between high-level cross-channel strategy and granular platform optimizations.

•
Agency Experience (Required): 3-5 years in a fast-paced agency environment, managing client relationships and significant media spend simultaneously.

•
Nonprofit Sector Knowledge: Experience working with nonprofits is highly preferred with an understanding of donor psychology, the "giving season," and nonprofit budget constraints.

Required Skills

•
Client Presentation Mastery: Proven track record of leading meetings and presenting complex strategies to senior-level stakeholders with confidence.

•
The Consultant Mindset: Proactive rather than reactive. You anticipate client needs and bring new ideas to the table before being asked.

•
Time Management: Consistently meets deadlines by organizing tasks, managing priorities, and avoiding last-minute scrambles. Demonstrates reliability in day-to-day execution.

•
Attention to Detail: Delivers polished, error-free work by catching inconsistencies and ensuring accuracy across all deliverables. Maintains high standards even under pressure.

•
Written Communication: Writes clearly and professionally, adapting tone and format to suit internal and client audiences. Avoids ambiguity and ensures messages are easy to understand.

•
Team Collaboration: Works well with others by sharing information, supporting teammates, and contributing to a positive team dynamic. Builds trust through dependability and openness.

•
Project Management: Plans and executes projects with clear timelines, milestones, and accountability. Keeps stakeholders info

title: Receptionist & Prior Authorization Specialist (Primary Care)
description:
We are seeking a proactive, highly organized Front Desk Receptionist & Prior Authorization Specialist to support a brand-new primary care practice launching this fall. Supporting a solo practitioner, you will serve as the operational backbone of the office-handling patient calls, managing scheduling, facilitating medication refill requests, and taking full ownership of insurance eligibility and diagnostic prior authorizations.
Because this is a solo medical practice, the ideal candidate is an independent self-starter who excels at multi-tasking and understands U.S. insurance workflows inside and out. Hands-on experience securing diagnostic prior authorizations (CTs, MRIs, specialty imaging, etc.) is an absolute requirement.

Schedule & Working Environment

•
Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week)

•
Start Date: Practice Opening October 5th (Onboarding prior)

• Schedule (US Eastern Standard Time - EST):

•
Mon, Tue, Thu: 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM EST

•
Wednesday: 11:00 AM - 7:30 PM EST

•
Friday: 8:30 AM - 12:30 PM EST (Half-Day)

Top 3 Daily Tasks

•
Prior Authorizations & Insurance Verification: Secure prior authorizations for diagnostic testing (CT scans, MRIs, lab work) and verify active insurance coverage before patient visits.

•
Inbound Phone Operations & Scheduling: Answer incoming calls, handle appointment bookings, answer patient inquiries, and step in if patients need assistance with the automated intake system.

•
Medication Refill & Prescription Requests: Field incoming phone requests for medication refills, gather clinical details, and route them to the physician according to practice protocols.

Core Responsibilities

•
Prior Authorization Ownership (Non-Negotiable): Submit, track, and follow up on prior authorization requests for diagnostic imaging (MRIs, CTs, Ultrasounds) and medications with commercial and government payers.

•
Front Desk & Call Management: Manage high-touch inbound phone calls professionally, maintain practice scheduling, and address administrative patient inquiries.

•
Clinical Administrative Support: Receive and process medication refill calls; compile pharmacy details and chart notes for provider review.

•
Automated Intake Backup: Monitor the practice's automated patient check-in platform, assisting patients remotely when manual intervention is required.

•
Consult & Fax Management: Process, track, and follow up on outgoing consultation faxes, medical record requests, and specialist reports.

•
EMR & Platform Navigation: Utilize Alasia Health and Ambient AI to document patient communications, record details, and manage daily workflows.

Requirements
Required Qualifications

•
Prior Authorization Experience (NON-NEGOTIABLE): Demonstrated hands-on background obtaining diagnostic (CT, MRI) and medication prior authorizations directly from insurance companies.

•
Insurance Verification Expertise: Thorough knowledge of U.S. health insurance plans, co-pays, deductibles, and eligibility checking.

•
Healthcare Front Office Background: Minimum 2+ years of experience in medical reception, patient scheduling, or primary care front-desk administration.

•
Schedule Agreement: Ability to work the exact designated 40-hour shift structure (including Wednesday late shifts and half-day Fridays).

•
Communication & Demeanor: Fluent spoken and written English; warm, welcoming, and reassuring phone presence.

•
Remote Setup: A private, HIPAA-compliant home office with a reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a clear headset.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Solo Practitioner Support: Experience working in a boutique, primary care, or small solo-provider practice environment.

•
EMR/AI Tool Familiarity: Experience using Alasia Health , Ambient AI , or comparable modern EMR platforms.

Ideal Candidate Profile
You are an articulate, resourceful virtual assistant who thrives in a solo-provider setting. You treat prior authorizations as a high-priority mission, take pride in keeping patient schedules full and organized,

• Maintains chain of custody on all documents, follows all confidentiality and security guidelines and completes assignments in a manner that meets or exceeds the contract quality assurance goals

Qualifications
Requirements:

• Current licensure as a Registered Nurse in one or more of the 50 states or D.C.

• Knowledge of and ability to use Microsoft Excel and word, Adobe PDFs and various internet applications

Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video https://youtu.be/gTPDn5XpeJg to explore what makes us unique.

- Review smaller vendor contracts: check them against our standard criteria, flag anything that needs a closer look from our Legal Counsels, and take the routine cases through to approval yourself

- Support our data protection work in close collaboration with our Legal Counsel Privacy & IT: reviewing DPAs and vendor privacy terms, keeping our records of processing activities up to date, and flagging where personal data is involved

- Draft and manage low-level partnership agreements with student associations, from first draft to signature

YOU BRING:

- First exposure to or genuine interest in civil law and IP law, whether from your studies or a previous role

- A structured, reliable way of working: the kind of person who finishes the filing, not just the interesting part of the task

- Clear, precise writing - you'll draft and comment on contracts that other AMBOSSians rely on

YOU ENJOY:

- You have good judgement about what you can decide yourself and what needs the owner of a senior team member and you'd rather ask once too often than once too little

- You're curious about how legal work connects to the commercial side of a business, and you want to see contracts in their real context rather than only in a seminar

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony.

🌴 Rest & Time Off (paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

title: 3PL Operations Manager
description:
iFIT ’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.

The 3PL Manager is responsible for the day-to-day oversight and performance management of iFIT 's North American third-party logistics partners. This role ensures product flows accurately and efficiently from inbound containers through final shipment, acting as the primary point of contact between iFIT 's internal operations and external 3PL providers. The 3PL Manager owns vendor accountability, order integrity, invoice accuracy, and continuous improvement across the logistics network.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
3PL Vendor Management

• Own day-to-day relationships with North America 3PL partners, including regular cadence meetings and onsite QBRs to drive performance and accountability.

• Serve as the primary point of escalation for 3PL operational issues, ensuring timely resolution.

Order Management and Fulfillment Oversight

• Review iFIT open order reports and compare to 3PL workflow dashboards to ensure dwell time accuracy.

• Ensure inbound orders are received, routed, and shipped accurately and on time; monitor exceptions and resolve delays proactively.

• Order pallets for all inbound containers and communicate with 3PL partners regarding incoming shipments.

SLA and KPI Performance Tracking

• Define, track, and report on key metrics including fill rate, on-time ship, dwell time, and accuracy.

• Hold 3PL partners accountable to agreed service levels; identify and escalate underperformance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with internal Sales and Customer Service teams to address order stagnation, dwell time issues, and logistics escalations.

• Communicate regularly with internal stakeholders on inventory status and fulfillment updates.

Invoice Review and Accuracy

• Review all 3PL invoices submitted to iFIT for accuracy prior to payment approval.

• Identify billing discrepancies and drive resolution with 3PL billing teams.

Process Improvement and Standardization

• Identify operational gaps across 3PL sites, develop SOPs, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and reduce cost.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3+ years of experience in logistics, fulfillment, or supply chain operations

• Direct experience managing or working alongside 3PL providers

• Familiarity with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)

• Experience with order management processes including routing, carrier selection, and exception handling

• Ability to travel regularly between the US, Canada, and Mexico

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Spanish language proficiency

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or a related field

• Experience leading or participating in 3PL RFP processes including requirements gathering, vendor scoring, and selection

• Contract negotiation experience with 3PL providers including rate cards, SLAs, penalties, and renewal terms

WHAT WE OFFER

• Competitive compensation with annual incentive plan

• Fully remote work environment with flexibility

• Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k)

• Opportunity to shape iFIT 's logistics network during a period of significant growth

DISCLAIMER
Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan, and exemption status. • Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend sustainable improvements.

• Translate business requirements into practical workflows and system configurations.

• Lead or support the implementation of Enterprise Project Management (EPM) solutions.

• Design and optimize reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance monitoring processes.

• Challenge and support clients in adopting more structured and data-driven ways of working.

• Act as the primary point of contact, ensuring alignment on expectations, progress, and outcomes.

What We're Looking For
Required Skills & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business, Information Systems, Project Management, or a related field.

Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software.
We operate two core platforms: Customize Now (our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network).

💻 The Role

We're not looking for a traditional data analyst. We don't need someone to sit between our systems and the business interpreting what the numbers mean. We need a builder who can take a stated requirement ("we need this tracked," "alert us when this breaks") and ship it: a dashboard, an automated pipeline, or a real-time alert.
A significant part of this role is exposing what’s already happening across our platforms: tracking when something enters a process, when it exits, and pinpointing where it gets stuck. This is closer to an automation and systems engineering role than classic business intelligence. You will work alongside our core engineering team and our Automation Engineer to connect, clean, and automate our entire data ecosystem.
We would rather hire someone scrappy and technical who figures things out (researches, builds, breaks things, and fixes them) than someone with a polished analytics background who needs well-defined problems handed to them.

You will own data across the entire organization. We are actively moving away from static dashboards and toward an AI-powered data engine where team members can type in natural-language queries, and the engine automatically fetches, processes, and analyzes the data in real time.
Ultimately, you will build the central data heart of THE/STUDIO-a system where automated, data-driven decisions execute seamlessly across our operations.

• Architect the AI Data Engine: Build toward our long-term vision of an AI-driven, natural-language query interface and contribute to automating operational decision-making across the business.

• Expose Process Timestamps: Surface stage-by-stage system events (entry/exit timestamps) across our core platforms to identify and fix operational bottlenecks.

• Engineer Workflow Automations: Build and maintain automated workflows (e.g., via n8n) linking our raw data sources directly to reporting and alerting tools.

• Solve Root-Cause Data Issues: Fix data quality and integrity issues directly at the source.

• Leverage AI as a Default: Use modern AI tools as a core build accelerant in your day-to-day workflow.

• Document for Enablement: Create clear, lightweight documentation so non-technical managers can use and navigate tools independently.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer, Motor Design & Prototyping
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings. Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve peoples’ lives.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer to lead the development of motor mechanical designs and prototype hardware for advanced robotic systems. You will own stator and rotor mechanical development from early concepts and detailed design through hands-on builds and prototype validation, partnering closely with electromagnetic, electrical, test, and manufacturing teams.

This role focuses on the design, integration, and validation of motor components and prototype processes, including laminations, stack assemblies, bobbins, winding interfaces, and fixtures. You will help drive motor development from initial design through repeatable low-volume builds while establishing the tooling, work instructions, and validation practices needed for future robotic platforms.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and requires in-person presence 4 days a week.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

- Own stator and rotor mechanical designs and released CAD and drawings, including geometry, interfaces, fits, tolerances, retention, assembly access, and mechanical validation.

- Develop laminations, stack assembly methods, bobbins, and winding interfaces that control alignment, insulation, conductor placement, and end-turn packaging.

- Design, fabricate, and debug fixtures for winding, stacking, assembly, alignment, and inspection.

- Build and troubleshoot prototypes. Use measurements, defects, rework, and assembly effort to improve designs and processes.

- Establish low-volume prototype production with equipment, build sequences, work instructions, revision control, traceability, and acceptance checks that let technicians reproduce successful builds.

- Test new manufacturing methods and winding approaches, balancing performance, repeatability, and practical implementation.

- Work with electromagnetic, electrical, manufacturing, and test engineers to resolve tradeoffs between motor performance, packaging, buildability, and validation.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

- Move comfortably between CAD, the shop, measurements, and hands-on builds, and take ownership of the physical result.

- Understand how tolerances, insulation, tool access, and assembly sequence affect whether a motor can be built and used reliably.

- Diagnose failed builds through evidence and focused experiments, then carry the fix into the next iteration.

- Build useful processes while designs evolve, and document them so others can reproduce the result.

- Communicate assumptions and tradeoffs clearly and resolve coupled problems across disciplines.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience designing and building motors, actuators, or other precision electromechanical assemblies.

- Experience with lamination stacks, bobbins, winding, insulation interfaces, or small-component assembly.

- Proficiency in 3D CAD, manufacturing drawings, tolerance analysis, and fixture design, with hands-on metrology and inspection of critical mechanical interfaces.

- Machining, additive manufacturing, bonding, or other prototype manufacturing processes.

- Experience turning an initial build into a repeatable low-volume process.

- Interest in using AI to reduce repetitive design and prototype work, with careful engineering review.

The Role

Legend is hiring a Group Head of Finance, reporting directly to our Finance Director.

In this role you will lead a 25+ person, multi-location team spanning Financial Reporting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Treasury and Payroll. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring someone who can operate comfortably at both strategic and detailed levels: setting the direction for the function while stepping into complex operational and technical challenges when required.

Following Legend's acquisition, the finance function is operating in an environment of increased complexity and change. A key part of your role will be to evolve Legend’s finance operating model to meet these demands by strengthening controls and accountability, standardising and automating processes, improving systems and data flows, and building a scalable organisation that is less dependent on individual knowledge or manual intervention.

You will lead through an established team of finance leaders, developing their capability and creating clear ownership across the function while maintaining high standards of delivery. You will also play a critical role in building effective relationships across Legend and the wider Genius Sports group, balancing the requirements of both while supporting the team through significant organisational change.

This role would suit an experienced finance leader who is energised by transformation and ambiguity and has a track record of leaving finance functions materially more scalable, controlled and effective than they found them. 

In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

Your Impact:

• Lead Legend’s 25+ person, multi-location finance function across Financial Reporting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Treasury and Payroll, creating clear accountability and ownership through the finance leadership team.

• Assess and evolve Legend’s finance operating model, ensuring organisational structure, process ownership, systems, controls and ways of working can scale with the business and wider Genius Sports group requirements.

• Lead end-to-end redesign and optimisation of core finance processes and systems, identifying opportunities to standardise, simplify and automate workflows while improving efficiency, controls and data quality.

• Establish clear process ownership, SLAs, controls and KPIs, using data to identify performance gaps, bottlenecks and opportunities for continuous improvement.

• Lead through managers and team leads, building their capability and empowering them to take ownership while remaining hands-on in complex operational and technical issues when required.

• Lead Legend’s finance function through post-acquisition integration, balancing the requirements of Legend and Genius Sports Group Finance and driving alignment across reporting, controls, systems, data and ways of working.

title: Senior Domain Expert, Total Rewards
description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the role

Syndio is the leader in compensation equity and pay decision intelligence, helping the world's largest employers make fair, defensible, and transparent pay decisions at scale. As Decisions expands across the compensation lifecycle - from leveling and offers to promotions and merit - the compensation practice depth behind our recommendations has to keep pace.

The Senior Domain Expert (Total Rewards) is a hands-on compensation practitioner on the Applied Pay Intelligence team. Draw on your past experience in total rewards strategy as well as Syndio -provided training on pay equity best practices to provide expert advice on advanced pay equity topics to customers, fellow employees, and external audiences. This is a senior individual contributor role. You are the person our customers, our product, and the rest of the team turn to when the question is how pay should actually be structured - job architecture, market data, pay ranges, offer construction, geographic differentials - and how it should hold up in front of a CHRO, a comp committee, or a works council.

You own an area of Syndio 's compensation content and product surface, build the 1:many resources that scale your expertise across the customer base, partner directly with Product to embed compensation practice into Decisions and Essentials, and show up in the customer conversations where the design choices have to hold. You will translate custom analytics into product requirements and support product and development teams as needed on design and implementation plans, partner with the data science and development teams to ensure the product helps advance the outcomes of our total rewards customers.

Why this job is exciting

•
Lead a squad. You will be an individual contributor but you will own an area of Syndio 's compensation content and product surface - job architecture, market data integration, pay range design, offer intelligence, or a related domain. Guide the squad's roadmap, prioritize what gets built on the Applied Expertise team, and hold the practitioner bar for the work that ships.

•
Apply total rewards expertise in complex customer situations. Work through the design questions customers can't resolve inside the product: architecture redesigns, market data conflicts, range strategy, offer logic, geographic differentials. Bring the practice, explain the tradeoffs, defend the approach.

•
Build 1:many resources. Turn recurring compensation questions into durable content - customer briefings, design guides, model communication templates, worked examples - so recurring questions do not require a recurring meeting.

•
Partner with Product. Work directly with Product and AI teams to embed compensation practice into Decisions and Essentials. Shape offer recommendation logic, range and structure inputs, market data workflows. Catch the practitioner-level edge cases before customers do.

•
Show up for the moments that matter. Anchor customer QBRs, offer strategy conversations, and architecture reviews where the design has to hold up under CHRO or board scrutiny. Not every meeting - the ones where getting the structure and the framing right changes the outcome.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

• Design and implement reinforcement learning solutions for sequential decision-making problems in real and simulated environments.

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupování s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

description:
ABOUT ZEGO 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Zego-Insurance-EI_IE1851459.11,25.htm.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Product Manager to join our Mobile Experience team. Our apps are where customers live with us day to day - recording trips, seeing their driving rating, managing their policy and getting help. For most of our customers, the app is Zego.

You’ll own a product domain within our apps, defining its quarterly strategy and goals and helping shape the longer-term direction of the Mobile Experience. You’ll lead discovery and delivery across iOS and Android, and use AI both to move faster and to build smarter experiences.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Define your domain’s quarterly strategy and goals, and help refine the longer-term plans for the Mobile Experience.

- Lead complex discovery autonomously, from customer research and design partnerships to opportunity solution trees and business cases.

- Craft mobile experiences customers prefer, from effortless onboarding to intuitive self-serve, that also cost less to serve.

- Validate before you build, using A/B tests, feature flags, staged rollouts and rapid prototypes to back or kill ideas early.

- Ship at pace in reusable building blocks across iOS and Android, working with engineering, design, data and compliance.

- Put the right metrics in place, from adoption and retention to app ratings and stability, and use them to drive continuous improvement.

- Establish AI-enabled workflows for your domain, and explore AI-powered experiences inside the app.

- Bring stakeholders along, running ceremonies with senior stakeholders, facilitating big-room planning and knowing when to escalate.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

- Mobile product ownership. A track record of owning a consumer mobile app, or a major area of one, and delivering material business impact in a high-growth environment.

- UX and customer instinct. You sweat the details of onboarding, permissions, notifications and accessibility, and know what makes great mobile experiences work.

- Experimentation mindset. Hands-on experience with A/B tests, feature flags and rapid prototypes. You default to evidence over opinion.

- Data and commercial fluency. Comfortable instrumenting events and analysing funnels in Amplitude, Looker or Snowflake, and building a business case around expected ROI.

- Technical literacy. Confident with engineers on native vs cross-platform trade-offs, APIs and release management. Ideally, you come from engineering or data science.

- Ownership and communication. A bias for action, and the ability to bring stakeholders with you across multiple teams.

- You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Space team is dedicated to expanding our AI-powered capabilities into the final frontier, enhancing Space Domain Awareness, Space Control, and Command and Control for U.S. military and allied partners. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our Guardians maintain a decisive advantage in this contested warfighting domain.

ABOUT THE JOB

You'll own spacecraft and payload structural analysis from conceptual design through environmental testing and launch. Unlike larger firms where analysts get siloed into statics or dynamics, you'll work across both. Most of our programs are early-stage, so you'll shape designs from the start and see your analysis carry hardware all the way to orbit.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Perform static and dynamic stress analysis - starting with hand calculations and first-order models before moving to detailed computational methods.

• Quantify load cases and environments for launch and on-orbit operations; determine strength, life, and safety margins.

• Collaborate with hardware engineers to guide design decisions based on analysis results.

• Support test campaigns - instrumentation selection, execution, data processing, and model correlation.

• Lead trade studies and mass optimization efforts.

• Prepare technical reports and present findings to internal teams and customers.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• BS or higher in engineering or applied physics with a focus in structures.

• Strong foundation in statics, dynamics, mechanics of materials, and materials properties.

• First-principles mindset - comfortable starting with hand calculations to frame problems before reaching for detailed tools.

• Experience with CAD tools (NX, Solidworks, or similar).

• Proficiency in MATLAB or Python for analytical models and data processing.

• Involvement in a hands-on technical project - competitive engineering club (FSAE, Baja, rocket team, aerospace club) or a co-op/internship analyzing or designing real hardware.

• Highly motivated, self-starting, and comfortable working autonomously.

• Organized and willing to define scope for problems with undefined requirements.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with FEA software (ANSYS, Abaqus, or NASTRAN).

• Structural testing experience - sensor selection, data acquisition, and post-processing.

• Co-op or internship in a startup or fast-paced engineering environment.

• Familiarity with industry standards for materials (MMPDS) or analysis methodologies (GSFC-STD-7000, NASA-HDBK-7002, NASA-STD-5020).

• Eligibility to obtain a U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

title: Senior ML Systems Engineer, Inference
description:
Runpod is the AI Developer Cloud. More than one million developers, from indie researchers to teams running frontier models in production, use Runpod to experiment, train, fine-tune, deploy, and scale AI on one platform. The platform has processed more than 20 billion inference requests. We closed a $100M Series A in June 2026. We're at an inflection point for AI infrastructure, and we're building the platform the next generation of developers will depend on.

 

We're a small, remote-first team. We take ownership seriously, move fast, and ship work that more than a million developers rely on every day. We're looking for people who care deeply, build with urgency, and want to matter at scale.

 

Learn more in our CEO's funding announcement: https://www.runpod.io/blog/one-million-developers.

We're looking for a ML Systems Engineer, Inference. We want Runpod to be the best place in the world to run LLM inference, meaning the fastest and the most cost-efficient. You'll lead that effort. You'll own LLM serving performance end to end. That means measuring it, understanding it, and improving it across models, hardware generations, and workloads. The work you ship will show up directly in the latency and cost our customers experience. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who likes finding the real bottleneck and fixing it, then turning that fix into something that runs reliably in production.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define how we measure inference performance, including throughput, time to first token, inter-token latency, and cost per token, and build the tooling that makes those measurements rigorous and repeatable.

- Profile and diagnose performance problems across the serving stack, from scheduling and memory management down to kernels and interconnect.

- Improve serving efficiency for large, state-of-the-art models on single-node and multi-node GPU deployments.

- Turn what you learn into production-ready runtimes, configurations, and defaults that customers benefit from automatically.

- Work closely with product and infrastructure teams to shape how inference is offered on Runpod.

- Keep up with the fast-moving inference ecosystem, including the open-source community, and decide what's worth adopting, what's worth building, and what's worth contributing back.

- Trace bottlenecks in the serving engine/runtime and implement fixes when configuration tuning is not enough.

REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years of professional system engineering experience.

- Deep, hands-on experience with vLLM, SGLang (or a comparable serving engine) in production or at serious benchmark scale.

- Strong software engineering skills in Python. You're comfortable working in large, performance-critical codebases.

- A solid understanding of what drives LLM inference performance: batching, memory, parallelism, and the trade-offs between latency and throughput.

- Experience with modern inference optimization techniques such as quantization, speculative decoding, or distributed serving.

- Rigor in benchmarking and performance analysis, plus comfort with GPU profiling tools.

- The ability to explain your results clearly in writing and turn them into decisions.

PREFERRED

- Experience writing or tuning GPU kernels in CUDA or Triton.

- Contributions to inference or ML systems projects.

- Experience with multi-node GPU systems and high-speed networking.

- Experience at a company where inference cost and latency were core business metrics.

What You’ll Receive:

- The competitive base pay for this position ranges from ($150,000 - $220,000). This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Runpod and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location

- Meaningful equity in a fast-growing company- everyone on the team receives stock options - your impact drives our growth, and you share in the upside.

- Generous medical, dental & vision plans

title: Sr. Account Manager, Sales, Target - Naturium
description:
About the Company
 
e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face. 
 
Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, e.l.f. Hair, Well People, Naturium and rhode.
 
In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 7 consecutive years of net sales growth. This consistent, category-leading growth is a testament to the strength of our team, strategy, and portfolio of brands. 
 
Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry. 
 
Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us

Position Summary
The Senior Account Manager is responsible for growing net sales and building brand market share at Target for Naturium. They will develop omnichannel sales plans, sell and execute directly to and with Target. They will optimize item distribution, shelf presence, off-shelf merchandising and retail pricing within their specific area of responsibility. Reporting to the AVP Sales, this position can be
based in a remote office, but with strong preference for proximity to Target’s corporate HQ in Minneapolis.
The ideal candidate is someone who embraces e.l.f.’s dynamic culture of executing with speed and quality to drive solutions. S/he needs to be a self-starter bringing at least 5+ years of relevant sales experience within beauty and specifically with Target. Strong time management skills are also necessary in this role as they will be asked to develop and execute a sales plan for their customers
ensuring net sales growth, market share growth and customer profitability. Lastly, the ideal hire will be someone who has demonstrable skills working effectively with both internal and external cross- functional partners while thriving in an entrepreneurial environment comfortable with collaboration across all parts of the business.

The base salary range for this role is listed above. 
 
Total compensation includes base salary, annual company-based performance bonus, and equity. Under e.l.f.’s annual bonus program, employees are eligible to earn up to 200% of their target bonus when company performance exceeds defined goals. In addition, e.l.f. provides a variety of other benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a retirement savings plan, gender neutral parental leave, and unlimited paid time off. The amount of total compensation (including base salary) offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including geographic location, experience, specific skills, and qualifications.
 
Compensation components are subject to change at the company’s discretion

title: Software Engineer (Python, React, TypeScript)
description:
About Cargobase

Cargobase is changing how enterprise shippers like Bosch, Reckitt Benckiser, Goodyear, and Textron, along with logistics providers like DHL, DSV, and FedEx, run spot-buy freight. This is a multi-billion dollar corner of logistics, and we're bringing the whole process online: quoting, tracking, invoice audit, and data insights.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on full-stack engineer who loves shipping across the stack and working AI-natively. You'll be a core builder on our small, high-trust team, helping us build agentic AI right into the product. You'll write the features our enterprise customers rely on and help set the technical bar for how we build and review code.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Ownership & Execution

• Ship meaningful full-stack features end to end, from design through to production, spanning both the UI and the services behind it.

• Bring agentic AI into the product (for instance, extracting structured data from unstructured sources like emails and documents) and help figure out where AI genuinely makes the experience better.

• Keep the codebase healthy through pragmatic architecture, sensible data modeling across relational and NoSQL stores, and a steady habit of tackling tech debt.

Process & Operational Excellence

• Work AI-natively by using agentic coding tools like Cursor or Claude Code fluently, applying them with smart, context-aware judgment rather than brute force.

• Help shape the engineering practices and standards that keep us shipping quickly and reliably.

Internal & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Level up the whole team through thoughtful, high-quality code reviews, setting the bar for how we build and review.

• Work closely with teammates and partners across Product and QA, turning real customer needs into solid technical solutions.

What We're Looking For

• You have over 5 years of experience shipping production software as a full-stack engineer, with a genuine balance between frontend and backend work.

• On the frontend, you're strong with React and TypeScript, with enough depth to guide and review frontend work effectively.

• On the backend, you're strong with Python and have experience with Django, FastAPI, or Flask.

• You're comfortable with data modeling across both relational and NoSQL databases.

• Working with Docker and in containerized environments like Kubernetes feels like second nature to you.

• You already work AI-natively, or you have a clear enthusiasm and fluency for that way of working.

Nice to Have

• It's a bonus if you've built agentic or LLM features into a product: things like RAG, vector search, structured extraction, or agent tool-calling, even if just through side projects.

• Experience with AWS (especially EKS), CI/CD ownership, and observability tools is definitely a plus.

• A background in enterprise B2B SaaS is great, especially if it's in logistics or supply chain.

Our Stack

We use Python (Django, FastAPI, Flask), React, and TypeScript. Our data lives in relational and NoSQL databases, and we run on Docker and AWS (EKS) with solid CI/CD. We also love AI-native tools like Cursor and Claude Code.

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Lörrach
description:
Du hast erste Vertriebserfahrung und willst jetzt richtig loslegen? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturiertes Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70% weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Outbound-Anteil (Kaltakquise, Walk-ins, eigene Terminierung).

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.
